name: Veðrfölnir Eagle
body:
VEÐRFÖLNIR EAGLE
CR 8/MR 3

XP 4,800
NG Large magical beast (mythic)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, piercing gaze; Perception +22

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate mountains
Organization solitary or pair (1 veðrfölnir eagle and 1 veðrfölnir hawk)
Treasure none

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 16, flat-footed 17 (+7 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)
hp 106 (9d10+57)
Fort +9, Ref +13, Will +7
Defensive Abilities evasion; Immune fear; DR 5/epic

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 160 ft. (average)
Melee 2 claws +14 (2d6+6/19–20/x3), bite +14 (1d6+6)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks aerial interception, mythic power (3/day, surge 1d6), powerful charge (2 claws, 4d6+9), twin talons

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 24, Con 16, Int 14, Wis 19, Cha 15
Base Atk +9; CMB +16; CMD 33
Feats Alertness, Death from Above, Eagle Eyes B, Flyby Attack, Improved Critical (claws), Improved Natural Attack (claws)
Skills Acrobatics +18, Climb +10, Fly +16, Knowledge (geography) +10, Perception +22, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +7; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception
Languages Auran, Celestial, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aerial Interceptor (Ex)

A veðrfölnir eagle has a fly speed of 160 feet and gains a +2 circumstance bonus on attack rolls when it attacks an airborne target as part of a readied action or attack of opportunity. In addition, a veðrfölnir can spend one use of its mythic power as an immediate action to ready an action to charge an airborne target.

Piercing Gaze (Ex)

A veðrfölnir gains Eagle Eyes as a bonus feat.

In addition, whenever it attacks a target with a miss chance due to concealment or total concealment it can roll twice and select the better result. In addition, a veðrfölnir can spend one use of its mythic power to ignore miss chances due to concealment or concealment“>total concealment until the beginning of its next turn.

Twin Talons (Ex)

A veðrfölnir can attack with both claws as part of the same attack action, charge action, or standard action. If the veðrfölnir hits the same target with both claws, it can attempt a drag combat maneuver against its target as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If the maneuver succeeds, the veðrfölnir can move with its target after making its attack as far as the drag maneuver allows, even if its movement for the round would otherwise have been completed. The target is not grappled and is released at the end of the drag maneuver, which may result in a fall if dragged into the air or off of a wall, tree, or other high place. If both the veðrfölnir and the creature it dragged are willing, the dragged creature can hold on long enough to mount the veðrfölnir on its next turn as a move action and begin riding it.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate mountains
Organization solitary, pair, or eyrie (3–12)
Treasure none

These heavenly fowl stand sentinel atop blessed treetops, mountain cliffs, temples, and feast halls of the blessed.

Their divine progenitors guarded the mighty World Tree itself, Yggdrasil, with the hawk perched upon the eagle’s head. They keep watch eternally for the enemies of their patrons, but they also enjoy trading insults and threats through messengers like the ratatosks, who are only too happy to carry caustic gospel back and forth.

When called to war, they are scouts par excellence, and one veðrfölnir eagle might carry several of its smaller cousins on its back or clinging to its talons, using its great speed to convey them to their scouting assignments and coordinating their efforts.

In some tales, veðrfölnir are known as viðópnir and resemble bright-plumed roosters rather than hawks. They are otherwise identical to the above.
